svg.text: GitHub Actions — event, workflow, job, step, runner
one YAML file. holds one or more jobs.
steps run in order, same runner
jobs run in PARALLEL by default.
each job gets a FRESH runner —
a clean virtual machine that GitHub creates for the job and destroys afterwards
GitHub hosted: free minutes, no maintenance, no access to your private network
self hosted: your machine, can reach private resources, you patch and secure it
1. Jobs are isolated. A file written in job A does not exist in job B unless you upload an artifact.
2. Steps in one job share a filesystem and a working directory. Jobs do not.
3. Every run starts from an empty machine. Nothing is cached unless you cache it deliberately.
